biography:
An experienced professional with over 13 years of expertise in a variety of industries (Technology, Automotive, Food & Academia). Demonstrated leadership by overseeing the acquisition of over 700MWs of critical data center capacity via land acquisition, build-to-suit, colocation and Hybrid leases. Experience executing a comprehensive strategy spanning across 15+ domestic and international markets and working through ambiguous situations. 

Leverages multilingual abilities (Spanish, English and basic Portuguese) to cultivate strategic partnerships with C-suite executives. Holds certifications in Negotiations, Data Center Design, Quality Engineering and Six Sigma. Exhibits advance problem-solving skills coupled with an analytical, results-oriented approach to exceed customer expectations. Leads pivotal initiatives in collaboration with diverse stakeholders including external suppliers, planning, energy, water, legal, engineering, and networking, facilitating critical business expansions and process improvements.
